standard_prerequisites.name: Characterization of qc on algebraic spaces

core_obligations: Lifting: etale covering {x_i -> x} with lifts u_i; x_i^*F|_{V_i} equals the restriction of f^*F by the comparison lemma (proof lines 662-672).
Conclusion: x^*F|_{V_etale} is qc on each member of the etale covering, hence qc by the Properties of Spaces characterization (proof lines 673-678).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to one smooth surjection from a scheme.
Check lqc on the lifting covering and conclude.
difficulty_reason: Single-chain descent: replace the covering stacks by schemes, take the disjoint union smooth surjection, lift an arbitrary object along an etale covering via the surjective-flat-lfp lemma, compare restrictions with the comparison lemma, and conclude lqc on the etale site of V by the characterize-quasi-coherent lemma of Properties of Spaces.
